summary: Never bake MCP server credentials into the execution environment image; pass them at runtime as environment variables or read-only mounted files (for example ~/.aws:/home/runner/.aws:ro), and in AAP use controller credential types.
questions: How do I pass credentials to an MCP server in an execution environment?
Is it safe to put AWS keys in the execution environment image?
How do I mount AWS credentials read-only in an execution environment?
